segments.title: The DRIEST desert just turned what color?
segments.say: One of the driest deserts on Earth just changed color. Bright blue, purple, or black? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: PURPLE flowers!
segments.say: Purple! It burst into flowers you can see from space.

segments.title: Atacama, Chile
segments.sub: One of the **driest places** on Earth
segments.say: This is Chile's Atacama, one of the driest places on Earth.

segments.title: Rare rains woke the seeds
segments.say: Rare El Niño rains woke up seeds hiding in the ground.

segments.title: Biggest bloom in decades
segments.say: Reports call it the biggest bloom in decades, and NASA's Landsat saw it from orbit.
